defs.meaning: <英>饼干；<北美>松饼（biscuit 的复数）

examples.en: These biscuits are great favourites with the children.
examples.zh: 孩子们特别喜欢这种饼干。

examples.en: Rationing had put an end to a surfeit of biscuits long ago.
examples.zh: 定量供应很久以前就结束了饼干过剩的情况。

examples.en: A medium-sized dog will devour at least one can of food plus biscuits per day.
examples.zh: 一只中等大小的狗每天至少要干掉一罐食物外加饼干。
